time.basis: relative wall time: tier "economy" factor 5000 × effort usage

apply.basis: Apply weights favour architecture and logic; floors rise with the upper bound of complexity/risk. Policy values, not benchmark facts.

verify.basis: Verify weights favour testability and consequences. Policy values, not benchmark facts.

pricing.note: Standard tier list price, micros per 1M tokens. Cache write = 30-minute write rate. Batch, fast mode, regional and priority surcharges are not modelled. Prompts above 272000 input tokens use the long-context rates.

selection.basis: Baseline prioritises quality (7:3); anchors are fixed so adding a candidate never rescales others. Published policy, not a benchmark fact.

workloads.basis: Scenario workloads per category (xs..xl) and phase; high includes possible rework. Uncalibrated heuristics until local completed changes are measured.
